player_prompt.intro:
U ena le Player {player_id} ho JoJoJoin, e tsebahalang ka boradeng ya 5x5 e nang le masae a nang le dinomoro tse 0-24.
Ha e le nako ya hao, bea letshwao la hao ho sae lefe kapa lefe le se nang letho, mohlala '[12]'.
U WINA ka ho fumana letshwao la hao la bone mafateng — masae a mane a latelana ka tatellano, ka godimo kapa tlase, kapa ka mokgwa wa diagonal.
E le Player {player_id} u ena le '{symbol}'; mohlankana wa hao ena le '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ho falla ho hlahisitsoeng ha hoa latela mokhoa o nepahetseng.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} hase sele e nepahetseng. E tlameha ho ba pakeng tsa 0 le 24.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Sele {cell} e se ntse e na le motho.

game_action.placed: Mopalya {player_id} o hlomeile tšwele ya hae ({symbol}) kwing ya {cell}.
